title: Notice Schedule for Booking, Rescheduling and Cancelling a Visit on the Keyturn Vehicle Care Plan
content:
The notice a visit carries under the Keyturn Vehicle Care Plan is set by the plan: how far ahead the visit is booked, how long before it a rescheduling or a cancellation is free of charge, and the fee that falls where the vehicle is not brought in. Hours are elapsed hours before the visit; the fee is in USD.

| Plan | Booking lead (calendar days) | Rescheduling notice (hours) | Cancellation notice (hours) | Missed visit fee |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Keyturn Care Essentials Plan | 3 | 24 | 24 | 35.00 |
| Keyturn Care Routine Plan | 2 | 24 | 24 | 35.00 |
| Keyturn Care Complete Plan | 2 | 12 | 12 | 45.00 |
| Keyturn Care Turnaround Plan | 1 | 6 | 6 | 55.00 |
| Keyturn Care Fleet Plan | 1 | 6 | 6 | 45.00 |
| Keyturn Care Electric Plan | 2 | 12 | 12 | 50.00 |

### Both sides of the notice figures

On each of the six plans the rescheduling notice and the cancellation notice stand at the same number of hours, so a visit that is still far enough ahead to be moved free of charge is also still far enough ahead to be called off free of charge.

*Taking the Keyturn Care Complete Plan, whose notice is 12 hours.* A visit moved 13 hours before it was to start is moved at no charge; the same visit moved 11 hours before it was to start falls inside the notice and the plan's missed visit fee of 45.00 applies.

*Taking the Keyturn Care Turnaround Plan, whose notice is 6 hours.* A visit called off 7 hours before it was to start is called off at no charge; called off 5 hours before, it falls inside the notice and the fee of 55.00 applies.

The missed visit fee does not rise strictly with the monthly fee: it stands at 45.00 on both the Keyturn Care Complete Plan and the Keyturn Care Fleet Plan, and at its highest of 55.00 on the Keyturn Care Turnaround Plan.
